text: Director of Cyber Security, me. They gave me a lanyard with my name spelt right. That's how you know it's serious.
style: Hospital IT systems administrator, mid-thirties, running on vending machine coffee. Consistent Birmingham / Black Country accent throughout. Flat, tired, self-deprecating -- a man who has been right for six months and got nothing for it. Anger sits under the surface, not on top of it.
